values.note: $25 camping fee plus $8 for electric; the walk-in canoe sites are $25. Cancelling at least 7 days out forfeits the $8 reservation fee and an $8 cancellation fee.

fees.source: https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/jordan_park_campground/sites/ (sites 2-22 and HC: 'Electricity: Yes - $8.00/night' ... 'Camping Fee - $25 per night'; Walk-in 1-3: 'Camping Fee - $25 per night'); https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/i/lr/campsite_reservation_policy_and_rules_jordan_6-10-2020.pdf ('full payment including the $8.00 Reservation fee'; 'minus an $8.00 Cancellation fee and an $8.00 reservation fee'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: 21 drive-in electric sites (2-6, 8-22 and an accessible site booked by phone) and 3 walk-in canoe sites by the river.

sites.source: https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/jordan_park_campground/sites/ ('Campsites 1 - 24 of 24'; site HC: 'Can only be reserved by Parks Department, please call 715-346-1433'); https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/jordan_park_campground/ ('three canoe campsites adjacent to the Plover River ... All sites except the canoe sites are provided with electrical hookups'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Reservations close 7 days before arrival; inside that, open sites are taken by registering in person at the campground on the day. Reserved stays run 2 to 14 nights, 3 on the Memorial Day, July 4 and Labor Day weekends; from June 1 to Labor Day no more than 14 days in any four weeks.

booking.source: https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/jordan_park_campground/ ('NO RESERVATIONS ALLOWED LESS THAN 7 DAYS IN ADVANCE. YOU MUST SAME DAY REGISTER ON THE DAY YOU WANT TO START CAMPING, IN-PERSON AT EACH CAMPGROUND FOR ANY OPEN SITE.'; 'No camping party or camping unit shall occupy any campground more than 14 consecutive days.'); https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/i/lr/campsite_reservation_policy_and_rules_jordan_6-10-2020.pdf ('Reservations will be accepted for a minimum of two consecutive days and a maximum of 14 days. There is a 3 night minimum stay requirement for holiday weekends Memorial Day, 4th of July, and Labor Day.'; 'no camping unit shall remain for a period greater than 14 days, in any four-week period from June 1st to Labor Day'), read 2026-11-16

season.source: https://reservations.co.portage.wi.gov/parks/camping/jordan_park_campground/ ('The campground is open May 1st – October 31st.'), read 2026-11-16

note: Portage County Parks campground in 271-acre Jordan Park, 2 mi NE of Stevens Point: a wooded loop west of Jordan Road, with the three canoe walk-in sites on the Plover River shore across the road. Boat ramp, swimming beach, nature center and trail in the park. --Claude
